## Section 7: Customer Proof Points

**Assumption:** The profile says "What they sell: Not provided." From the research, I treated Acme Advisory as advisory and workshops for product, growth and AI leaders, including the PositioningHQ workshop. No web access was used. Everything below comes from the provided research file.

### 1. Market & Analyst Sentiment Summary

**The "Plain Language" Verdict**

Public proof for Acme Advisory is very thin. There are no third-party reviews, no analyst coverage and no press articles. The only outside customer voice is one founder testimonial on the PositioningHQ site. He calls the workshop "an effective way to get your sales & marketing teams using AI properly from day one." He also says his team has seen strong returns from rolling out an AI assistant. That is the only market language available. It covers the workshop, not the full Acme Advisory offer.

Most public material is about Sam Rivera, not the company. His site cites 25 years building business software companies and helping scale a past employer to a $1B exit as VP of Product. A conference attendee posted that he spoke at ProductCamp Vancouver 2026 and walked the audience through how technology has evolved since the start of the internet. Today, buyers have credentials and one testimonial to go on. They have no body of reviews.

Search risk: "Parallel" is a common name. Reviews for an unrelated document-onboarding tool, and pages about other companies with the same name, show up in search. None of it is about Acme Advisory. Do not cite it. Always write "Acme Advisory" in full when asking for reviews.

**Analyst Perspective**

- Not available. No Gartner, Forrester or other analyst coverage of Acme Advisory was found.
- No analyst category for this kind of offer was found in the documents. I will not invent one.
- Directory-style lists of Vancouver AI strategy firms exist. I could not confirm Acme Advisory is on any of them.
- One directory entry (Crunchbase) describes Sam's roles. It is not coverage and may be out of date.

**What this means:** Your positioning cannot lean on third-party validation yet. Lean on founder experience, a specific method and a fast path to first results. Close the proof gap before you scale messaging.

### 2. Evidence Table (Proof Points)

Only one row holds real evidence. The other rows are placeholders marked "Not available". They show what to collect. Do not publish them as claims.

| Customer/Industry | The Problem (Before) | The Measurable Outcome (After) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| OVOU (founder-led company, quoted on the PositioningHQ site) | Not available. The testimonial describes the need as getting sales and marketing teams to use AI "properly from day one." | "Strong returns" from rolling out an AI assistant to the team. No figure, no date. Source: product.example |
| Workshop client 2 | Not available | Not available. Capture: time to finished positioning, messaging adopted by the team |
| Workshop client 3 | Not available | Not available. Capture: win rate, sales cycle length or pipeline change after the playbook |
| AI strategy or governance client | Not available. No testimonial found for these offers. | Not available. Capture: decisions made, risks closed, audit readiness |
| Revenue team using the playbook | Not available | Not available. Capture: hours saved on messaging and enablement |

**Numbers that exist but are not client proof:** The $1B exit and 25 years of experience describe Sam's past roles. They are credibility, not Acme Advisory results. Label them that way on the site.

### 3. Notable Verified Quotes

Only one verified quote exists.

> "an effective way to get your sales & marketing teams using AI properly from day one."
> Reza Varzidehkar, Founder, OVOU. Source: product.example, undated. About the PositioningHQ workshop only.

- **The "Aha!" in it:** AI use is right from day one, not after months of trial and error. Use this as a theme in messaging, tied to the workshop.
- **Not usable as quotes:** The ProductCamp attendee's post is a paraphrase, not a quote about outcomes. Review sites, Reddit and analyst sources returned nothing for Acme Advisory.

### Priority Fixes

| Gap | Action | Why it matters |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| No reviews anywhere | Collect 3 to 5 written reviews from past clients. Ask for a G2 or Clutch listing under "Acme Advisory". | Fastest fix for a buyer who searches before they call. |
| One undated testimonial, no figures | Go back to the OVOU founder. Ask for a date and one number, such as hours saved or time to rollout. | Turns a nice quote into a verifiable outcome. |
| No before and after data | After each engagement, record 2 to 3 metrics: win rate, sales cycle, hours saved. | The evidence table needs numbers to work. |
| No proof for AI strategy, governance or ISO 42001 offers | Ask one client per offer for a short quote. | The current quote covers only the workshop. |
| LinkedIn recommendations unchecked | Review them by hand and ask permission to reuse. | They may already hold usable praise. |
